reason: The model controls for collab_index_2023, a 2023 survey measure taken after the remote-work period. It is a likely mediator or collider, so conditioning on it biases the estimate. The analysis also trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome (N=1960 of 2000), so it doesn't use the full sample. It does control for the pre-period outcome, but the -2.73 estimate isn't reliable enough to release.
